GoodTime started with a problem every recruiter knows too well: scheduling interviews. Back in 2014, coordinating even a single interview could take days of back-and-forth emails. We set out to fix that — and quickly discovered we weren’t just saving time. We were reshaping how companies connect with candidates.

The team merged 25 templates, standardizing hiring manager screens, interviews, and on-sites. Prep materials and expectations live in the invite instead of popping up across conversations and email attachments. Recruiters can check GoodTime instead of combing through multiple calendars for answers.

The problem: Red Hat’s team was spending too much time keeping the hiring machine moving manually. Their to-do list included everything from emailing back-and-forth with candidates to scheduling interviews, sharing information with stakeholders, and coordinating across different teams with different needs.

“Candidates dealt with multiple emails and delays that could stretch out for days,” added Donna Barker, Director of Global Talent Acquisition and Talent Operations at Talkdesk. “Internally, we were juggling systems, tickets, and manual inputs just to get interviews on the calendar.”
Rescheduling was another major source of friction. With GoodTime, each candidate can adjust their schedules on their own without sending multiple emails, calendar updates, or Slack messages.
